collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLC Class SUV 2018 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz GLC Class SUV 2018 - 2022 (253) model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this GLC Class, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
